findings.message: runtimeGOOS is a global variable
findings.next_step: narrow the declaration scope / remove the dead store or global (see skill)
findings.exempt_reason: `runtimeGOOS` is the PRESCRIBED production seam for the platform (0.14.0 P1 Task 1.12: "a package-level var in app/cast.go that tests may assign - not a test-file function"). It is initialised once from runtime.GOOS and written only by tests, which restore it via t.Cleanup. It exists so the M5 fallback matrix can walk BOTH platform namespaces on one machine; without it half the matrix would never execute on the developer's box or in CI, which is the failure the seam is bought to prevent. Same class as the ratified platform/tz and platform/render/themes.go rows, with a narrower write surface. RATIFIED by the HUM LEAD 2026-09-05 ("exemptions ratified"), recorded in 06_docs/02_features/multi-voice-support/04-development/director-build-log.md (PL-14/PL-16).

findings.message: P10-08: //go:build directive — justify or exempt (conditional compilation)
findings.next_step: remove the directive, or record a justified exemption (see skill: Exemptions)
findings.exempt_reason: F-21b, the alert injector: a SAFETY split, not a portability one. A screenshot of a fabricated tornado warning is indistinguishable from a real one, so the capability must be ABSENT from a release binary rather than switched off inside it — a runtime gate is one config mistake from being reachable; a build tag is not in the file the linker reads. app/inject_debug.go (watchpost_debug) defines Inject and a real queue; this file (!watchpost_debug) defines an empty queue answering the same take(), so the two builds share one call site in the tick and neither carries a dead field. TestInjectionIsAbsentFromAReleaseBuild asserts the split structurally, because a rule about WHICH CODE EXISTS cannot be asserted behaviourally (F-22). PRESENTED FOR RATIFICATION at the F-21 gate; removable only by giving up the guarantee that a shipped binary cannot fabricate an alert. RATIFIED by the HUM LEAD 2026-09-05 ("exemptions ratified"), recorded in 06_docs/02_features/multi-voice-support/04-development/director-build-log.md (PL-14/PL-16).

findings.exempt_reason: THE ONE CLOCK-DRIVEN LOOP IN app/ (0.14.0 T3.2a).
